name: Market Pass Payment
author: marketpass

sections.description:
MarketPass Payment integrates a new payment method into your WooCommerce store, allowing customers to use MarketPass Vouchers to complete their purchases.

Customers enter their voucher code directly on the checkout page and complete the order, replicating the simplicity of an in-store purchase online. The payment form is fully integrated into the standard WooCommerce flow with no external redirects, improving the user experience and maximizing conversions.

Main Benefits

  • Expand Your Payment Options: Allow customers to use MarketPass vouchers on your online store with zero complexity.
  • Improve User Experience: Keep customers on your site with a seamless, integrated checkout process (no redirects).
  • Simplify the Checkout: An easy-to-use input form and instant voucher validation reduce checkout friction.
  • Easy Admin Management: View the voucher code used for a transaction directly in the WooCommerce order details.

Features

  • MarketPass Voucher Payment Gateway: Validates and applies MarketPass vouchers at checkout.
  • Integrated Checkout: The payment form appears directly on the standard WooCommerce checkout page.
  • Secure Validation: Vouchers can be used for payment of an order.
  • Localization Ready: Fully prepared for translation with the marketpass text domain.

External services

This plugin connects to an API to validate vouchers during the checkout process. It is required to confirm whether a customer’s voucher can be used to pay for their order.

It sends the voucher code entered by the user and the total amount of the cart.
The API for the validation is provided via auth.trecuori.org and auth.dev.trecuori.org (for testing purposes only).
This service is provided by TreCuori S.p.A.: Privacy Policy | Terms of Use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the marketpass plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Enable “MarketPass Payment” and click “Manage”.
  5. Enter the API credentials (username and password) provided by MarketPass and save your changes.
  6. The payment method will now be available on your checkout page.
sections.faq:
Where can I get the credentials to configure the plugin?

The API credentials (username and password) must be provided directly by MarketPass.

Does the plugin support partial payments?

No. If the voucher amount is less than the cart total, the customer will not be able to use the voucher.
